_note: Story 1 Krypta der Verdammten on the story runtime (src/hell/hell_game.gd): the hell balance (assets/data/hell_balance.json) with the crypt monsters (monsters.data / monsters.sprites, written by tools/krypta_dungeon/export_monsters.js), their experience per kill and the undead that rise from a broken grave seal.

feel._note: As hell_balance.json monsters.feel without its lava slosh (the crypt has none): the crypt figures' impacts shake, hold and flash by importance, push the hero back, their shockwaves and screams shove the pixels (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd _impact, _knock, _blow_front).

knock._note: Knockback of the hero when a monster's blow lands (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd _knock, skill gamedev:physics-tuning): start speed in px/s away from the blow by kind, easing out quadratically over time s (the push covers about speed x time / 3 px); a mob's knock is mob_scale of it. Control stays the hero's; walls stop each axis.

blow._note: Pressure fronts shoving pixels (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd _blow_front, skill gamedev:game-feel): a shockwave's ring and each of a scream's four sound arcs push the pixels they pass outward at push px/s (world) times the arc's share in fronts (first arc to last); the scream's first arc lifts one dust pixel per dust_area px^2 of the cone it sweeps; a front at half share or more makes every lava cell it crosses slosh lava_drops [min, max] drops.
